problem: The lead promises three ways to steer, but the third item (skid-to-turn versus bank-to-turn) is a turn convention, not a steering effector. A student may expect three hardware types in Section 2 and get only two plus a body-orientation choice.
fix: Write: 'two hardware ways to push the body sideways — aerodynamic fins, and thrust vector or reaction jets — plus a choice of how to orient the body while turning: skid-to-turn or bank-to-turn.'

problem: 'BTT gives more lift per degree of angle of attack' is misleading. For the same angle of attack the body lift is essentially the same; the real BTT gain is that it can fly at a higher usable angle of attack (all lift in one plane, small skid angle), so it produces more lift before the limit and better lift-to-drag.
fix: Write: 'BTT allows a higher usable angle of attack with the lift kept in one plane, so it pulls more lift for the same fin size; it also keeps a ramjet inlet in clean flow, but the roll costs time.'

problem: 'Why are fins useless during boost?' is too broad. Boost lasts seconds and speed, hence q, rises quickly; the trap section itself says 'at launch'. The answer repeats the over-general claim.
fix: Ask 'Why are fins of little use in the first moments after launch?' and answer: 'Speed, and hence q = ½ρv², is still low, so fin lift and hinge moment are small; TVC supplies the control until q builds up.'

problem: 'Gyros (rate, free, dynamically tuned) sense the resulting motion' sits inside the fin-actuator discussion, so 'the resulting motion' reads as the fin's motion. Gyros sense the missile body's angular rate or attitude and feed the autopilot, not the fin loop.
fix: Write: 'The autopilot needs body rate and attitude to generate the acceleration command; rate, free and dynamically tuned gyros do that job (their physics is in Unit 5). Only the position sensor feeds the fin loop.'

problem: 'Every homing missile is built around this chain' contradicts Section 2 and the Beyond box, which describe exo-atmospheric interceptors steered by reaction jets where fins do nothing.
fix: Write: 'Nearly every endo-atmospheric homing missile is built around this chain.'
